“David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
translations.bsb: While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, He asked, “How can the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?
translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?
translations.asv: And Jesus answered and said, as he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that the Christ is the son of David?
